# Commit speedup (ask first)

Speed up slow commits in big repositories.

## Steps

1. Measure how long the last commit took with git's trace timing.
2. Turn on the filesystem monitor and untracked cache for this repository only.
3. If hooks are the slow part, show the user which hook takes the time. Never change the hooks path or disable hooks in config.
4. Only if the user asks to skip hooks for one specific commit, run that single commit with --no-verify and say which checks were skipped. The secret scan is never skipped.
5. Reply listing every setting changed, that it applies to this repository only, and how to undo each one.
